name: Kanban Board
description: A shared kanban board where tasks move through To Do, In Progress and Done
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may view the board; require auth for creating, updating, moving and deleting tasks; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Tasks: any signed-in user may create, update, move and delete any task; DELETE /api/tasks/:id removes the task permanently

Task validation: title is a required non-empty string of at most 200 characters; description, when given, is at most 2000 characters; status is one of todo, in_progress, done (default todo); priority is one of low, medium, high (default medium)

Ordering: position is a task's 1-based place within its status column, and each column's active tasks always hold positions 1 to n without gaps; a new task goes to the end of its column, and deleting or deactivating a task closes the gap

PATCH /api/tasks/:id changes only the fields it is given; a new status without a position moves the task to the end of the new column; a position places the task there within its (new) column and shifts the others, and a position past the end places it last

GET /api/tasks returns active tasks ordered by column (todo, in_progress, done) and then position; ?status= and ?priority= filter exactly; total counts every matching task and counts gives the number of active tasks per status
Deactivated tasks (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/tasks and answer 404 on the public task endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the board read-only; signed-in users also get the add, edit, move and delete controls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to edit the board' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Three columns, To Do, In Progress and Done, each headed with its task count and listing its tasks by position
Task cards showing title, a priority badge and the start of the description; selecting a card opens its full details

Signed-in users move cards between columns and reorder them within a column by drag and drop, with keyboard-accessible move controls as an alternative; the board updates in place and reverts if the API rejects the move
Add and edit forms for title, description, priority and status that show the API's validation messages; delete asks for confirmation first; a priority filter narrows the board
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every task, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts
Toggle a task's active status from the overview

api_endpoints.description: Active tasks ordered by column and position, with per-status counts

query.status: Exact status: todo, in_progress or done
query.priority: Exact priority: low, medium or high

api_endpoints.description: Create a task at the end of its column
Change some of a task's fields, including moving it to another column or position

data_models.name: Task
data_models.description: A card on the shared board

fields.title: string (required, max 200 chars)
fields.status: string (one of: todo, in_progress, done; default todo)
fields.priority: string (one of: low, medium, high; default medium)
fields.position: integer (1-based place within its status column; no gaps)
fields.updated_at: datetime (auto, changes on every update, ISO 8601 in JSON)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the task from public endpoints)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every task with counts
